tasks.label: Publicar Flappy Crédito no GitHub Pages
tasks.command: git init --initial-branch=main && git add index.html style.css game.js business.js && git -c user.name="Jaquelaurenti" -c user.email="jaquelaurenti@users.noreply.github.com" commit -m "Publish Flappy Credito demo" && gh repo create flappy-credito-credia-girls-demo-2026 --public --source=. --remote=origin --push && gh api repos/Jaquelaurenti/flappy-credito-credia-girls-demo-2026/pages -X POST -F 'source[branch]=main' -F 'source[path]=/' --jq '.html_url'

tasks.label: Diagnosticar GitHub Pages
tasks.command: gh api repos/Jaquelaurenti/flappy-credito-credia-girls-demo-2026/pages --jq '{status, html_url, build_type, source}' && gh run list --repo Jaquelaurenti/flappy-credito-credia-girls-demo-2026 --limit 5 --json name,status,conclusion,url

tasks.label: Consultar Pages e último commit remoto
tasks.command: GH_PAGER=cat gh api repos/Jaquelaurenti/flappy-credito-credia-girls-demo-2026/pages --jq '.status' && GH_PAGER=cat gh api repos/Jaquelaurenti/flappy-credito-credia-girls-demo-2026/commits/main --jq '.sha'

tasks.label: Inspecionar deploy ativo Pages
tasks.command: GH_PAGER=cat gh api repos/Jaquelaurenti/flappy-credito-credia-girls-demo-2026/deployments --jq '.[0] | [.id, .ref, .environment, .created_at] | @tsv' && GH_PAGER=cat gh api repos/Jaquelaurenti/flappy-credito-credia-girls-demo-2026/pages --jq '[.status, .source.branch, .source.path] | @tsv'
